title: ExampleNet launches Edge Shield, a managed web application firewall
text: ExampleNet today announced Edge Shield, a managed web application firewall available on every plan. Edge Shield blocks SQL injection, cross site scripting and credential stuffing at the edge. During the beta, 4,200 customers protected 1.3 million domains and Edge Shield blocked an average of 18 billion malicious requests per day. Edge Shield is free on the Pro plan and above.

title: Pulse DNS turns five
text: Five years ago we launched Pulse DNS, our privacy first public DNS resolver. Pulse DNS now answers 2.1 trillion queries per day with a median response time of 11 milliseconds. We never log client IP addresses, and an independent audit confirmed this commitment again this year.

title: ExampleNet 2026 Threat Report: bot traffic hits a new high
text: Our annual threat report finds that automated bots made up 31 percent of all HTTP traffic, up from 27 percent last year. The largest DDoS attack we mitigated peaked at 6.1 terabits per second and lasted 80 seconds. Financial services was the most attacked industry, followed by gaming and retail.

title: Postmortem: DNS resolution outage on June 3
text: On June 3 between 14:02 and 14:49 UTC, a configuration change caused DNS resolution failures for about 9 percent of Pulse DNS queries. No data was lost or exposed. We rolled back the change and are adding staged rollouts and automatic rollback for resolver configuration. We apologize to every customer who was affected.

title: Vault Gateway brings zero trust access to small teams
text: Vault Gateway is our new zero trust access product that replaces VPNs for teams of any size. It is free for up to 50 users. Vault Gateway checks identity and device posture on every request and works with existing single sign on providers.

title: ExampleNet expands to 340 cities
text: Our global network now spans 340 cities in 125 countries, after adding 18 new locations this quarter, including Lagos, Lima and Ulaanbaatar. About 95 percent of the world's internet connected population is now within 50 milliseconds of an ExampleNet data center.

title: Welcoming our new Chief Financial Officer
text: ExampleNet appointed Dana Okafor as Chief Financial Officer. Okafor joins from a public cloud software company where she led finance for eight years. She will report to the CEO and oversee finance, investor relations and procurement.

title: Developer Week recap: Workers SDK, durable queues and a free AI tier
text: During Developer Week we released a new SDK for edge functions, durable queues for background jobs, and a free AI inference tier with 10,000 requests per day. More than 1 million developers now build on the ExampleNet platform.

title: ExampleNet reports second quarter results
text: Revenue for the second quarter was 512 million dollars, up 28 percent year over year. The company added 3,100 large customers, defined as those paying more than 100,000 dollars per year. Gross margin was 77 percent.

title: Our commitment to protecting election websites
text: Through our free election protection program we now protect more than 430 state and local election websites in 34 states at no cost. Protection includes DDoS mitigation, a web application firewall and uptime monitoring during election periods.

title: Opening our Lisbon office
text: We opened a new office in Lisbon that will host 250 employees across engineering, support and sales by the end of next year. Lisbon becomes our fourth hub in Europe after London, Munich and Amsterdam.

title: Hybrid work policy update
text: Internal: starting November 1, employees near an office are expected in the office three days per week. Teams choose their anchor days. Remote employees hired as remote are not affected. Questions go to the People team.

title: Security awareness training deadline
text: Internal: all employees must complete the annual security awareness training by October 31. The course takes about 40 minutes. Employees who miss the deadline will lose access to production systems until it is complete.

title: Brand guidelines and logo downloads
text: Internal: the brand hub has the current logo files in SVG and PNG, the color palette (primary orange, slate and white), typography rules, and approved partner lockups. Do not stretch or recolor the logo. Request custom assets from the Design team.

title: How to work with the Communications team
text: Internal: send press inquiries to PR and never reply to journalists directly. Social handles all posts on company accounts. Design makes banners, slides and graphics. Internal Comms owns the newsletter, all hands and the Company Hub. Exec Comms writes speeches, talking points and letters for executives. Give at least five working days for non urgent requests.
